outcomes.statement: An authorized admin starts offboarding from either existing detail screen; the shared entrypoint executes removal via the shipped connector capability or checklist fallback, reaches deprovisioned, closes exactly the anchored register rows with ended_on/end_reason and refreshes capacity through the approved source-aware next-sync rule.
outcomes.demo: On person and request detail, remove API and checklist-backed active seats; each transitions offboarding->deprovisioned only after removal success/confirmation, closes the correct register row for each of the three reasons and exposes updated pool capacity at the next authoritative refresh. Failure keeps the register open; retry/concurrent confirmation cannot duplicate closure/audit; another company or wrong role is refused.

outcomes.statement: An admin explicitly confirms person-wide departure while starting seat removal, sees Salió del grupo, and can remove a seat for inactivity/reallocation without marking the person departed; reuse the first child entrypoint and both existing detail screens.
outcomes.demo: A person with two anchored seats across accounts in one company is marked departed only when the admin confirms departure, and both removals start atomically. Without confirmation, status remains unchanged; inactive/reallocated do not mark departure. A foreign-company seat or concurrent status/start failure rolls back the departure update and audit.

outcomes.statement: The existing quarter-hour alert-eval job raises request-subject deprovision_overdue and delivers its configured email when a left_company removal remains offboarding past the approved business-day deadline, across connector/checklist failures, with repeat-safe alerts and completion suppression.
outcomes.demo: Simulated Ecuador holiday/weekend calendars prove no alert before the deadline and a request-linked breach at the first tick after it; pending and failed connector/checklist removals alert, inactive/reallocated and completed requests do not. Repeated ticks deduplicate, email uses the existing outbox, and company/account scope is enforced.

uncertainties.statement: Which business-day calendar, cutoff, offboarding-start timestamp and non-business-day rule govern BR-14?
uncertainties.resolution: REQUESTED, not approved: reuse the operator-maintained ECUADOR_HOLIDAYS calendar injected by apps/worker/src/index.ts and America/Guayaquil dates; deadline is local midnight ending the start business day, rolling a weekend/holiday start to the next business day. Anchor on the current offboarding RequestTransition occurred_at, not job/action retry time. First existing 15-minute alert-eval tick after the deadline raises the breach, even on a non-business day. Existing isEcuadorBusinessDayDeadlineOverdue implements the date rule, but product authority and holiday maintenance ownership need a Nous decision. Cost-if-wrong: +45 minutes for a different cutoff/calendar/anchor; a new configurable calendar service requires reassessment, not silent expansion.

uncertainties.statement: Do inactive/reallocated removals also raise deprovision_overdue?
uncertainties.resolution: REQUESTED confirmation: only left_company, as BR-14 and AC4 explicitly say. Do not extend this alert to inactive/reallocated. Cost-if-wrong: +15 minutes for reason filtering and adversarial exclusions; a new SLA for those reasons must be named in the canonical ruling.

uncertainties.statement: What does pool increments next sync mean for API, csv_import and manual accounts?
uncertainties.resolution: REQUESTED, not approved: close the register at confirmed removal, never optimistically increase pool capacity when offboarding starts. API accounts refresh observed pool availability on the next successful member sync. For csv_import/manual accounts the next accepted member snapshot/import or explicit manual pool refresh is the authoritative sync-equivalent; show stale availability until then. US-055 owns import/manual-entry UI, not removal finalization. Cost-if-wrong: +35 minutes for an immediate local capacity projection or a different source-aware refresh contract; new ingestion UI is outside this estimate and requires repartition.

uncertainties.statement: Is Person departed automatic, optional, or separately confirmed, and does departure remove all seats?
uncertainties.resolution: REQUESTED, not approved: explicit admin confirmation in the left_company departure flow controls setting persisted Person.status=departed (display Salió del grupo), in the same audited transaction that starts removal of all open anchored seats for that person in the authorized company. Default confirmation unchecked; inactive/reallocated never change person status. Request-detail removal targets its own anchored assignment and leaves person status unchanged unless the admin explicitly chooses the person-wide departure flow. Existing people repository auto-marks departed for left_company and the input has no confirmation; this is a delivered precedent, not an approved new policy. Cost-if-wrong: +30 minutes for automatic status or a different multi-seat atomicity rule.

uncertainties.statement: When does the register close, and how are failed/confirmed-but-incomplete removals treated by the SLA?
uncertainties.resolution: REQUESTED, not approved: ended_on is the Ecuador date of successful connector removal or admin checklist confirmation, end_reason is the immutable accepted reason; persist assignment close, action completion and offboarding->deprovisioned atomically and audit once. Failure/retry leaves the assignment open and the request offboarding. BR-14 alerts every left_company request still offboarding after its deadline, including failed actions or inconsistent confirmed actions, until deprovisioned; current alert query requires latest removal.status=pending and an open assignment, so these exclusions need correction/verification. Cost-if-wrong: +30 minutes for a different close date, confirmation semantics or alert eligibility.

uncertainties.statement: Is the parent executable within the 320-minute and cohesion limits?
uncertainties.resolution: Resolved: 3 SP at the supplied 384 min/SP calibration forecasts 1152 minutes. Bottom-up reuse-aware delivery estimate is 780 minutes (270+240+270), still above 320, with three primary outcomes, five scopes, eight acceptance flows and 40 expected files. Phase sums include readiness, production wiring, focused verification, review and integration. Twelve shards is a conservative upper sum; actual overlap is identified in each child preflight. No blanket waiver from the smaller child estimates; if the bounded design exceeds a child limit, repartition before implementation.
